speaker: Patanjali
title: Gracious peace of the mind
text: By sympathy with the happy, compassion for the sorrowful, delight in the holy, disregard of the unholy, the psychic nature moves to gracious peace. When we are wrapped up in ourselves, shrouded with the cloak of our egotism, absorbed in our pains and bitter thoughts, we are not willing to disturb or strain our own sickly mood by giving kindly sympathy to the happy, thus doubling their joy, or by showing compassion for the sad, thus halving their sorrow.
modern_interpretation: To achieve lasting inner calm and mental well-being, cultivate genuine empathy: celebrate others' successes, offer support during their struggles, appreciate goodness, and avoid dwelling on negativity. When we're trapped in self-pity or excessive self-focus, fueled by ego, we miss the chance to uplift others and, in turn, find our own peace, preventing joy from expanding and sorrow from diminishing.
summary: Cultivating sympathy for the joyful, compassion for the sorrowful, delight in the virtuous, and detachment from the unvirtuous leads to profound inner peace, whereas self-absorption perpetuates one's own suffering and isolates from shared human experience.
actionable_advice: Actively practice empathy daily: genuinely celebrate a friend's success and offer sincere support to someone struggling, rather than retreating into your own thoughts.
embedding_ready_text: This ancient Yogic wisdom from Patanjali's Yoga Sutras (1.33) highlights that cultivating genuine sympathy for the happy, compassion for the sorrowful, delight in goodness, and healthy disregard for negativity is the direct path to profound inner peace and mental well-being. It corrects self-absorption, explaining how ego-driven focus on our own pains prevents us from sharing joy and alleviating sorrow, thus perpetuating our suffering. This transformative teaching encourages emotional regulation and empathy, addressing problems like relationship pain, social isolation, and a negative mindset, by guiding us towards a life of connection, kindness, and harmonious emotional intelligence, leading to an unshakable inner calm.
